Wire the `plainkeep search` command to query the vault's SQLite+sqlite-vec index so that notes are retrievable from the terminal alongside the existing benchmark queries.

## Why waiting

Waiting on the libSQL migration decision (ADR-002, not yet written). The current `plainkeep` stack uses a local SQLite file; if we migrate to a libSQL server instance the connection string changes and this integration must target the new endpoint. Do not start until ADR-002 is accepted.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `plainkeep search "<query>"` returns top-5 vault notes with slug + excerpt
- [ ] Results include both keyword (BM25) and vector (sqlite-vec) scores
- [ ] Response time under 200 ms for a 58-note vault on M-series Mac
- [ ] Integration test added to `tests/` using the existing benchmark fixture

## Blocked by

- ADR-002 (libSQL vs local SQLite final call)
- `plainkeep` CLI v0.2 release (adds plugin hook needed for the search subcommand)
